title: 8563份问卷里，藏着孩子对AI的真实想法 (The Paper, survey methodology interview)
notes: The Paper (top-tier outlet), interview with lead researcher Sun Hongyan. Supports: multi-stage random sampling May-Jul 2025, 7 provinces, 8563 valid questionnaires, 61.7% used AI, 71.0% homework, 67.9% families no AI rules, 51.2% of poor-teacher-relationship students only want to chat with AI. Note minor date/fieldwork discrepancy vs [73].
